card.name: Inside DNA-damaging drug and assay names
card.fires_on: Partway through names of DNA-damaging chemotherapy drugs, their metabolites, and DNA damage assays, such as ifosfamide, cyclophosphamide, azathioprine metabolites and the alkaline elution assay. It also fires on the space or bracket just before a dose number.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word repair, as in DNA repair, and away from integration and transformation words.
card.plain: It lights up in text about drugs that damage DNA, and nudges the model toward words like repair.
